text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day while working quietly in my
office, I start
to have trouble focusing.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hello. Oh, you look a bit tired.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't work long hours without
breaks,
okay? But I've got just the thing
for times like
this...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Here. It's some dried squid I bought in
the
shopping district!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yup, a fellow bronze collector. I just felt this connection with it, so I bought it, and it's amazing.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Each bite is packed with more flavor
than the last!
Highly recommend.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Right? It just can't quite win that
contest...
choice_data_list: You kind of sound like Nature.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! What, that part? You won't get
anything
for flattery except dried squid,
just so you know.
choice_data_list: She's an Umamusume who really grow...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Forget about me. Let's take a break, all
right?
Here, eat some more squid!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I try some of the dried squid with Nice
Nature.
She's right, it does have a taste
that grows on
you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Here's a present for you! Even more of
that dried
squid from the shopping
district!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm glad you liked it. But that's not
all today.
choice_data_list: It's that delicious dried squid fr...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If you dip the squid in this mayo with
pepper
flakes...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
See? All it takes is one little
addition to

quadruple the taste!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, I realize something!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, did you just get another of those
eureka
moments? I'm rooting for you
but, don't push
yourself too hard.
choice_data_list: (I should add a little twist to Na...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, as I'm enjoying the novel sweet
and spicy
flavor, I work on a revised
training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Here's a present for you! Even more of
that dried
squid from the shopping
district!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well, apparently they want
feedback on it
since the Tasty Delicacies
Contest is just around
the corner.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
They say chewing dried squid helps you
think
better, so why don't we take a
break and have
some together?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, possibly thanks to the squid,
both my
desk work and Nice Nature's
training go
exceptionally well.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Would you like some dried squid that won first place in the Tasty Delicacies Contest?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The old man at the dried goods store
was crying
tears of joy. I was so happy
for him.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
He gave me some squid to celebrate. I
insisted on
paying for it, but he just
wouldn't allow it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So, wanna take a break? Thinking makes
you
hungry, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, we enjoy the taste of squid and
victory.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's throw a celebration party!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Here. It's some dried squid I bought in
the
shopping district!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yup, each bite is packed with more
flavor than
the last! Highly recommend.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I have to do my best too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Nothing. Let's eat some dried squid,
Trainer!
